title: 1940s Young Couple Outdoor Portrait, B&W Snapshot 1947
description: A clear black-and-white 1947 snapshot featuring a young couple standing together outdoors in front of leafy foliage. The woman wears round eyeglasses, a patterned dress, and a wide-brimmed summer hat, while the man wears a classic 1940s suit with wide lapels and a tie. The back bears a handwritten date of June 28, 1947.
